# deploy.txt: app deploy 子命令
# 对应 deploy/deploy_test.go

# list 正常退出
exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app deploy list --app $BKMS_APP_ID --env $BKMS_ENV_NAME
stdout .

! exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app deploy list --env test
outcontains 'required'

# 逗号分隔多个环境名正常退出
exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app deploy list --app $BKMS_APP_ID --env $BKMS_ENV_NAME,$BKMS_ENV_NAME
stdout .

# 不存在的环境失败
! exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app deploy list --app $BKMS_APP_ID --env nonexistent-env-12345
outcontains 'not found'

# precheck：仅验证命令不崩溃，不断言退出码
exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app deploy precheck --app $BKMS_APP_ID --env $BKMS_ENV_NAME

! exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app deploy precheck --env $BKMS_ENV_NAME
outcontains 'required'

! exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app deploy precheck --app $BKMS_APP_ID
outcontains 'required'

# create error cases
! exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app deploy create --env $BKMS_ENV_NAME -f /tmp/nonexistent.yaml
outcontains 'required'

! exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app deploy create --app $BKMS_APP_ID --env $BKMS_ENV_NAME
outcontains 'required'

! exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app deploy create --app $BKMS_APP_ID --env $BKMS_ENV_NAME -f /tmp/nonexistent-deploy-spec-xyz.yaml
outcontains 'not found'

# delete error cases
! exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app deploy delete --env $BKMS_ENV_NAME --yes
outcontains 'required'

! exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app deploy delete --app $BKMS_APP_ID --yes
outcontains 'required'

! exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app deploy delete --app $BKMS_APP_ID --env nonexistent-env-12345 --yes
